rules.name: even_ranks_only
rules.description: Only cards with an even rank (2,4,6,8,10,12)

rules.name: spades_only
rules.description: Only cards of the suit spades

rules.name: different_suit_same_color
rules.description: The card must be of a different suit than but same color as the card just before it. Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1]
return card.color == prev.color and card.suit.suit_name != prev.suit.suit_name

rules.name: alternating_face_number
rules.description: Alternate face and number cards. Any card may start the line.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev_is_face = mainline[-1].rank >= 11
curr_is_face = card.rank >= 11
return prev_is_face != curr_is_face

rules.name: max_two_consecutive_color
rules.description: No more than two consecutive cards may be the same color. Any card may start the line.

rules.name: face_red_number_black
rules.description: Face cards must be red; number cards (1-10) must be black.

rules.name: hearts_spades_clubs_diamonds_cycle
rules.description: Suits must repeat in the order hearts → spades → clubs → diamonds → hearts …
rules.code:
order = ["hearts", "spades", "clubs", "diamonds"]
if not mainline:
    return card.suit.suit_name == "hearts"
prev = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name
expected = order[(order.index(prev) + 1) % 4]
return card.suit.suit_name == expected

rules.name: paired_suits
rules.description: Suits must appear in pairs: card 1 and 2 same suit, cards 3 and 4 same suit (different from 1 and 2), cards 5 and 6 same suit (different from 3 and 4), etc.

rules.name: red_prime_ranks
rules.description: Only red cards whose rank is prime numbers (2,3,5,7,11,13) may be played.
rules.code:
primes = {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13}
return card.color == "red" and card.rank in primes
